facts.value: Law Plus places significant emphasis on the development of practical legal skills including oral and written communication skills, analytical and logical reasoning skills, negotiation, legal research, organisational and teamwork skills, particularly through the lawyering skills modules.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study Law Plus at UL?

facts.value: These skills are of course transferable and of great benefit to those who choose to pursue a career outside of law.

metadata.chunk_title: Why study Law Plus at UL?

facts.value: real-life experience invaluable to a career in law
